scope: Router orchestration, AppShell, access guard, render recovery, return destination contracts and module structure consistency.

sourceReference.method: Read selected private corporate wallet sources to observe file organization and responsibilities; no corporate implementation copied or included in this project.
observedPatterns: Domain modules with pages and components
Component directory index.tsx with colocated use<Component> hook
Services imported by hooks instead of view components
sourceReference.limits: Presence of a file or historical code is not proof of individual authorship of every line or an objective quality score. Reference code was not treated as flawless.

adherenceMatrix.criterion: Router contains route declarations rather than UI/state/effects
State and effects colocated in dedicated hooks

adherenceMatrix.limit: Account and checkout still consume shared transport contracts and infer local form state; no unused re-export files were fabricated to claim literal parity.

adherenceMatrix.criterion: Error boundary uses supported React mechanism
adherenceMatrix.limit: React render-error capture requires the class boundary; extracting it into an unsupported hook would be artificial. The recovery action is a colocated hook.

adherenceMatrix.criterion: Secondary routes are lazy without delaying homepage UI behind a module barrel
adherenceMatrix.limit: Bundle size and Lighthouse improvement must be measured by the separate performance reviewer.

adherenceMatrix.criterion: Theme changes do not reset route forms
adherenceMatrix.limit: Recovery key depends on pathname/search, not theme or fragment. Final cross-theme E2Es owned by independent reviewer.

fixedFindings.issue: router.tsx bundled route declarations, four UI components, session fetching and document effects in one file.
fixedFindings.fix: Extracted app components, colocated hooks and shared types.

fixedFindings.issue: Session verification failure was shown as signed-out state because Guard ignored query errors.
fixedFindings.fix: Access model distinguishes loading/unavailable/guest/authenticated; failed verification has retry UI and never mounts protected children.

fixedFindings.issue: Return-to helper discarded root catalog query strings and Guard only kept pathname.
fixedFindings.fix: Pure allowlisted destination normalization preserves internal query/fragment and rejects external, unrelated and control-character destinations.

fixedFindings.issue: Forced scrollTo on pathname transitions competed with TanStack scroll restoration.
fixedFindings.fix: Removed imperative scrolling; router scrollRestoration remains the single owner.

fixedFindings.issue: All secondary page implementations were imported eagerly through module barrels.
fixedFindings.fix: Homepage direct import; secondary named-export lazy route components; authenticated pathless parent retains public URLs.

fixedFindings.issue: Render fallback claimed cart persistence regardless of storage availability and framework route errors lacked a uniform custom fallback.
fixedFindings.fix: Neutral Portuguese recovery UI with no persistence promise; both React boundary and router default error fallback use it.

removedOrRewritten: Replaced vague no-persistence and private-storage comments in checkout helpers with the actual recovery/in-memory invariant.
preserved: Socket.IO import must occur after MSW patches WebSocket
commentReview.reserved: Did not mutate performance/domain/HTTP comments or visual-agent source.

newE2E.covers: Session failure retry, guest distinction and full login deep link preserving query/hash.

independentReview: API reviewer reported no blocker in route guard/returnTo after source reading; new patches still require final root/independent consolidated run.

qualityScore.reason: No self-awarded numeric score. This matrix records observable adherence, measured validation and limitations; a prior score is not evidence.

publication: No publication or submission performed by this agent.
